item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00071","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C15","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.9,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied concrete drafting machinery for the child. Both proclamations concern the application or suspension of trade-agreement tariff treatment under section 350, organize the operative text into numbered Parts, use the customs trigger “entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption,” and—most distinctively—make the treatment depend on a later presidential notification to the Secretary of the Treasury published in the Federal Register. The child adapts that machinery from activating concessions by notified date to suspending concessions and prohibiting specified fur imports by notified country and date. C15 and C13 share closely related tariff-suspension or termination structures, but use dates fixed directly in the proclamation rather than C22’s reusable notification mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"shall be suspended with respect to imports from such nations and areas ... specified in any notification ... given by the President to the Secretary of the Treasury, and published in the Federal Register","parent_excerpt":"the date which may be notified by the President to the Secretary of the Treasury and published in the Federal Register as the date on and after which the concession represented by such rate should not be withheld","explanation":"This is a distinctive shared administrative mechanism: later presidential notification to Treasury, coupled with Federal Register publication, controls when tariff treatment changes."},{"child_excerpt":"which are entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on such date as may be specified","parent_excerpt":"if, when the article is entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption ... the date is prior to the date which may be notified","explanation":"Both use the same customs-status formulation and connect it to the effective date established through notification."},{"child_excerpt":"PART I ... reduced rates of duty (including rates of import tax) established pursuant to trade agreements ... shall be suspended","parent_excerpt":"PART I ... modifications of existing duties and other import restrictions ... and ... customs or excise treatment ... shall be effective ... subject to ...
